canonical_title: Lateral translation response in hovering flight
subject_group: 6.1.10 Vertical/short takeoff and landing air vehicles

versions.title_at_revision: Lateral translation response in hovering flight
versions.text: Criterion: Verify that lateral translation response in hovering flight is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.7.2.1.6 Lateral translation response in hovering flight (see table XCVI for guidance). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, design, test, or configuration documentation.

versions.title_at_revision: Lateral translation response in hovering flight
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle is no worse than Level 2 as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Lateral Translation Response in Hovering Flight paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis of hover lateral translation velocity response to evaluate air vehicle capabilities for all required hover loadings and configurations, to include: a. Baseline control system. b. Precision hover modes. c. Tasks should include both left and right translations and 45-degree diagonal translations. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess flying/handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Lateral Translation Response in Hovering Flight paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Baseline control system. b. Precision hover modes. c. Tasks should include both left and right translations and 45-degree diagonal translations. Pilot will assess overall workload, pilot compensation, and any undesirable coupling into other axes. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess flying/handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD- 1797, Lateral Translation Response in Hovering Flight paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Baseline control system. b. Precision hover modes. c. Tasks should include both left and right translations and 45-degree diagonal translations. Pilot will assess overall workload, pilot compensation, and any undesirable coupling into other axes.
